today.theme: Keep a conversation going with genuine curiosity
today.source: TED — Celeste Headlee: 10 ways to have a better conversation
today.listen_task: First pass: identify two habits the speaker asks you to stop and the question style she recommends instead. With the transcript, notice how her follow-up questions hand the focus back to the other person.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, ask a new colleague about their first weeks in the team. Use one open question and one follow-up question, then briefly share a related experience of your own.

phrases.note: A warm, low-pressure prompt that helps the other person continue.

phrases.phrase: What was that like for you?
phrases.note: Invite a personal detail instead of steering the conversation back to yourself.

phrases.phrase: I’m not familiar with that — could you explain it?
phrases.note: Stay curious when a colleague mentions an unfamiliar tool, place, or practice.
